onChange.template: [Category: movement] Apply the Dynamic art style to Slide Direction Lock. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Smooth art style to Slide Direction Lock. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Precise art style to Slide Direction Lock. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/slide_lock.schema.json, set slc_enabled to {{slc_enabled}}]
Set slideDirectionLockEnabled to {{slc_enabled}} in MovementAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/slide_lock.schema.json, set slt_threshold to {{slt_threshold}}]
Set slideDirectionLockThreshold to {{slt_threshold}} in MovementAbility.
